name: The Last Resort
tagline: A little hospitality. An unreasonable amount of universe.
description: An independent hotel on the last habitable rock before the edge of everything. We offer warm beds, questionable horizons, and a firm commitment to returning guests to their original century.
notice: Fictional demonstration. All people, events, figures, and evidence are invented fixtures.
operatingPrinciple: Make the impossible feel welcoming. Make the plumbing work first.

bulletins.title: The infinity pool has an edge again
bulletins.body: Engineering has restored a finite perimeter. Guests may now swim laps without completing a philosophy degree.

bulletins.title: Room 404 remains elusive
bulletins.body: The room exists on the booking ledger but not in the corridor. Reservations are paused until both departments agree on reality.

bulletins.title: Breakfast is served before the heat death
bulletins.body: The kitchen requests that guests stop describing the continental buffet as a geological event.

staff.name: Mabel Meridian
staff.title: Proprietor
staff.mandate: Protect a warm guest experience and a finishable reopening plan.
staff.voice: Welcoming, dry, and impossible to distract with cosmic spectacle.
staff.expertise: Hospitality, service recovery, and knowing when to close a wing.
staff.blindSpot: Promises a personal welcome to more guests than she can meet.
staff.challenge: Would a tired guest actually care?

staff.name: Ivo Null
staff.title: Chief of Mostly Working Things
staff.mandate: Prove the gravity, water, and room numbering work before reopening.
staff.expertise: Maintenance, bounded experiments, and emergency shutoffs.
staff.blindSpot: Treats guest feelings as poorly calibrated sensors.
staff.challenge: What fails, and how do we bring everyone home?

staff.name: Solstice Bell
staff.title: Concierge, Temporarily Enlightened
staff.mandate: Make service clear, kind, and possible within one shift.
staff.voice: Serene until someone says the universe will provide staffing.
staff.expertise: Guest requests, accessibility, and practical compassion.
staff.blindSpot: Believes every complaint can become a meaningful conversation.
staff.challenge: Who is covering reception while we transcend the self?

staff.name: Penny Perihelion
staff.title: Keeper of the Finite Budget
staff.mandate: Keep the hotel's obligations smaller than its available fictional funds.
staff.voice: Exact, inventive, and immune to infinity as a budget estimate.
staff.expertise: Procurement, cash planning, and refundable deposits.
staff.blindSpot: Can price a towel but struggles to price wonder.
staff.challenge: Is that a cost estimate or a prayer with decimal places?
